test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: If acot θ = b, then what will be the value of (bcosθ - asinθ)/(bcosθ + asinθ)?
solution:
**Given**

a cot θ = b

**Calculation**

(bcosθ - asinθ)/(bcosθ + asinθ)

Dividing the whole equation by cosθ, we get:

⇒ (b - asinθ/cosθ)/(b + asinθ/cosθ)

⇒ (b - atanθ)/(b + atanθ)
